task.title: To create a Display Map
task.shortdesc: Rakesh Singh Example Click Display Map and select Create .

step.cmd: Click Display Map and select Create.
In the Name field, type Main and from the Type drop-down, select List.
Drag the Account Name field to A7. This field was not available in Objects, but X-Author for Excel automatically includes the Name field for any lookup field selected in Objects.
Drag Name to B7, Amount to C7, Close Date to D7, Stage to F7, Opportunity Id to H7.
Click Options and change the Sort by list to Account Name.
To save the Display Map, click Save and then click Close.
Add a title in A1, for example, Opportunities Forecast.
